parsed_json.sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.record_id = m.substrate_record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = cr.molregno ORDER BY cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key LIMIT 200
